title: Integrated Climate + Water + Crop Health Risk
objective: Integrate independently derived climate exposure, water-stress indicators and crop-health concern scenarios into a transparent screening-level decision-support framework.
formula: Integrated Risk = 0.35 * Climate Risk + 0.35 * Water Stress + 0.30 * Crop Health Concern

data_sources.crop_health: PlantVillage benchmark via Phase 13 MobileNetV2 model

interpretation: Phase 14 is a proposed screening-level decision-support framework. The climate and water components represent observational indicators. The crop-health component is scenario-based because Phase 13 images are not temporally linked to the climate observations.
